flow: ui-path — setInputFiles on the composer's hidden file input and read the attachment chip back (VERIFIED live 2026-09-23)

steps.note: Anonymous chat — no session snapshot needed.

The attach button (button[aria-label='Add images or PDFs'], class PskLiaYNlcPUquZPq1Cs) wraps a hidden input[type='file'] with accept="image/png,image/jpeg,image/webp,image/gif,application/pdf,.pdf". setInputFiles directly (the filechooser never fires). Payload: args.path, or args.file={name,mimeType,data|path}, or args.data(base64)+args.name. Mimes outside the accept list are REJECTED by the runner (honest — the site won't attach them).
ATTACHED read-back: composer renders the attachment chip (e.g. aria-label 'Remove image 1', class aYkHt4TxswVPtfPDUObH).

rpc: The uploaded file rides the NEXT POST /duckchat/v1/chat request as a content part: {type:'image', mimeType, image:dataUrl} for images or {type:'file', content:base64, encoding:'base64', mimeType, filename} for documents (bundle-verified). Upload itself is executed by the site's own handler — never synthesized.
stealth: setInputFiles feeds the site's own attach handler exactly like a drag/drop from the user's disk; identical uploader codepath, no forged request.
